choices.why: A true light grey three-seat sofa with clean, wide arms that suits the modern white room and fills the long left wall well.
A large 200x300 plain flatweave in soft beige defines the seating zone and keeps the room bright and calm over the grey wood floor.
A square light ash coffee table, as requested, sized right in front of the sofa with a modern Scandinavian look.
A low, long off-white console with open shelves blends into the white walls and keeps the room luminous opposite the sofa.
The black arc lamp reaches over the sofa for reading light and echoes the black frame of the balcony door.
Burnt-orange cushions add the warm pop of color the user wants against the grey sofa, and their neutral tassels tie in with the rug.
A tall areca palm brings lush green beside the bright balcony door and fills the corner at the end of the sofa.
White sheer curtains soften the large sliding door while letting in all the light, keeping the room luminous.

answer.why: The light grey sofa, white console, beige rug and sheer white curtains keep the living room bright and modern. Light ash wood, a black arc lamp echoing the door frame, orange cushions and a green palm add warmth and color for entertaining friends.
